component.name: bbpc
component.summary: Play Bloodborne natively on Linux from your own copy of the game

description.p: A native Linux port of Bloodborne (CUSA03173, version 1.09) with a launcher for the game folder, the settings, mods and online play. It needs the player's own game files; none are included. bbpc is a fork of bloodborne_pc (bbport) by deadinside28 and its contributors.
